categories.name: First steps
categories.metric: One-time: the first sleep schedule (target bedtime, wake time, wind-down length) saved in onboarding or Settings. Counts once, ever.

categories.name: Nights tracked
categories.metric: Distinct nights after setup with a main sleep episode of at least 3 h from an accepted source. Source ladder, best available per night: (A) asleep stages from Apple Watch or an allow-listed hardware tracker (HKSource/HKDevice); (B) asleep samples from other apps (counted for leaves but excluded from rarity reporting); (C) iPhone 'In Bed' samples from Apple's Sleep schedule, labelled 'estimated from iPhone'. Samples marked HKMetadataKeyWasUserEntered never count. A night runs 18:00 to 18:00 local and belongs to the evening. The main episode is the longest cluster of samples, with gaps under 60 min merged; naps are ignored. The install night counts if setup finished before the episode began. Each night is evaluated provisionally the next morning and re-evaluated for 72 h as late Watch data syncs; results can only upgrade. The counter is a high-water mark. At most 1 per night.
categories.data_source: HealthKit sleepAnalysis → MapleCore SleepSourceResolver + night grouping → SleepNightSummary + per-category high-water marks (localHealth store, device-only)

categories.name: On-time bedtimes
categories.metric: Tracked nights whose sleep onset falls between target bedtime − 2 h and target bedtime + 30 min. Onset is the start of the main episode's first asleep block of 20 min or more (sources A/B), or in-bed start for source C (estimated from iPhone, which in practice means the phone was put down by then). Onset more than 2 h early (for example when ill) is 'early': neutral, never counted against you. The target is the schedule in force at 18:00 that evening, with weekday and weekend schedules respected. The very first schedule applies immediately if saved at least 30 min before its bedtime. At most 1 per night; cumulative.
categories.data_source: HealthKit onset (or iPhone in-bed start) vs SleepSchedule (MapleCore schedule maths)

categories.name: Bedtime runs
categories.metric: On-time nights in your current run. The run continues while at least 5 of every 7 nights are on time: up to 2 slips (late or untracked) in any rolling 7 nights add 0 and are forgiven, and a 3rd slip within 7 nights ends the run. Untracked nights count as slips, so taking the Watch off never helps; early nights are neutral. A leaf unlocks when the live run reaches its threshold. The progress bar shows the live run, with your best run as a quiet 'best: 13' marker. Capped at 30. Run leaves are never auto-picked as the home 'next leaf' (the run appears as its own line); a user can pin one.
categories.data_source: Derived from on_time_bedtimes night results (MapleCore LeafEngine)

categories.name: Steady weeks
categories.metric: Calendar weeks (using the locale's first weekday) with at least 5 on-time bedtimes, counted when the week closes. Early and untracked nights are neutral. Cumulative.

categories.name: Seasons in rhythm
categories.metric: Meteorological seasons for your hemisphere that close with at least 8 steady weeks. North: spring Mar–May, summer Jun–Aug, autumn Sep–Nov, winter Dec–Feb; flipped for the south. The hemisphere comes from region or time zone and is editable. A week belongs to the season that contains its Thursday. A season counts when its last week closes, and a season joined partway still counts if it reaches 8. Cumulative.

categories.name: Steady mornings
categories.metric: Mornings whose final wake falls within ±30 min of that day's target wake time. Final wake is the end of the main episode's last asleep block (sources A/B), or in-bed end for source C. At most 1 per day; cumulative.
categories.data_source: HealthKit final wake (or iPhone in-bed end) vs SleepSchedule

categories.name: Full nights
categories.metric: Tracked nights whose main episode has total asleep time of at least your sleep need − 30 min. Sleep need is set in onboarding (default 7 h 30 min, adjustable 7–9 h). Naps and extra hours add nothing. Needs asleep-stage data (sources A/B). With iPhone in-bed data only, these 10 leaves show 'Needs Apple Watch or a sleep tracker' and are left out of that member's tree stage, next-leaf choice and rarity reporting.
categories.data_source: HealthKit sleepAnalysis asleep duration (SleepNightSummary) vs Profile sleep need

categories.name: Focus hours
categories.metric: Credited minutes from in-app focus sessions. Each session needs a planned length of 10–90 min and is timed with a monotonic clock (ContinuousClock), so changing the device clock does nothing. If ended by a tap (in the app, a Live Activity or a notification) before or within 10 min after the planned end, it is credited the time focused, up to the planned length. If it isn't confirmed within 10 min, credit is capped at 25 min. Sessions under 10 min credit nothing, and minutes inside your wind-down or sleep window never count. Caps: 3 h per day and 10 h per calendar week. From M3, sessions with Screen Time blocking count in full and unblocked sessions count at half rate here; focus days and focus weeks still count them fully. Stored as minutes, shown as whole hours.
categories.data_source: FocusSession records (synced store); from M3 the blocking flag from ManagedSettings

categories.name: Focus days
categories.metric: Calendar days with at least one focus session that credits 25 min or more on its own (same session rules as focus hours). At most 1 per day; cumulative.

categories.name: Focus weeks
categories.metric: Calendar weeks with at least 3 focus days, counted when the week closes. At most 1 per week, so even a full-time focuser can climb at most one rung step per week. Cumulative.

categories.name: Sound wind-downs
categories.metric: Nights where a Maple sleep sound played for at least 15 min, starting between wind-down start and target bedtime + 30 min, and the same night was on time (or, from M3, the wind-down was scroll-free). Longer or louder playback adds nothing. Revealed the next morning. At most 1 per night.
categories.data_source: AudioMixer session log (local) + on_time_bedtimes / scroll-free night result (localHealth store)

categories.name: Scroll-free wind-downs
categories.metric: Wind-down windows (wind-down start to target bedtime) that were monitored from their start by Maple's rolling DeviceActivity schedule, ended, and had no 5-min usage-threshold event for your wind-down apps. The selection must count for leaves: at least one category token (Social and Entertainment are preselected), or at least 3 apps whose combined daytime use reached 10 min on 3 of the previous 14 days (from a daytime threshold event). Selection changes apply after 7 days. A window with a missing start or end callback is neutral. At most 1 per night.
categories.data_source: DeviceActivityMonitor extension (one rolling activity per window type, re-armed in intervalDidEnd) → App Group EventStore

categories.name: Phone-free mornings
categories.metric: Mornings where your final wake fell between target wake − 30 min and target wake + 15 min (otherwise the morning is neutral and counts nothing), and your morning apps had less than 2 min of use before final wake + 30 min. Measured by one rolling DeviceActivity window from target wake − 30 min to target wake + 45 min, with a 2-min threshold event whose time is recorded and compared with HealthKit's final wake. The same 'counts for leaves' selection rule applies. Alarms, music, maps and phone calls are always allowed. Maple's own reveal stays closed until 30 min after wake, so Maple never competes with this window. At most 1 per day.
categories.data_source: DeviceActivityMonitor morning window → App Group EventStore + HealthKit final wake

categories.name: Shield nights
categories.metric: Nights where the bedtime shield (ManagedSettings) was active from target bedtime to the end of its schedule, over a selection that counts for leaves, and you never took 'five more minutes' or turned blocking off (ShieldAction logs every unlock). Nights when the shield's selection was edited that day are excluded. At most 1 per night.
categories.data_source: ManagedSettings schedule + ShieldAction extension events → App Group EventStore

categories.name: Reflection weeks
categories.metric: Calendar weeks with mood-and-energy check-ins saved on at least 3 different days, counted when the week closes. Every mood counts the same. This replaces daily mood check-ins, so there is no daily tap habit to keep up. Cumulative.

categories.name: Caffeine curfew
categories.metric: Days with a habit-journal entry recording no caffeine after your curfew (default 8 h before target bedtime, adjustable 6–10 h). Only journaled days are evaluated, and logging late caffeine simply adds nothing. Evaluated the next morning. At most 1 per day.

categories.name: Wind-down rituals
categories.metric: Evenings with a completed wind-down ritual of at least 3 min (breathing, meditation or a journaling prompt), started within 2 h before target bedtime. Revealed the next morning. At most 1 per evening.

categories.name: Community challenges
categories.metric: Completed opt-in community challenges. Up to two are offered each month (for example 'fall asleep on time 12 nights in November' or 'six scroll-free wind-downs this month'). Each is built only from the capped categories above, can be done solo, and is evaluated on device; nothing about you is uploaded. Cumulative.
categories.data_source: Challenge definitions read from the CloudKit public database; completion evaluated on device by LeafEngine (synced store)
